summary: Verified all 6 correction requests on EdTech Ops Hub. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed (10 new correction tests in test_corrections.py + 14 regression in test_backend.py). Frontend: SOW preview shows S.No first + Dates after Hours with '5 Jun, 8 Jun, 15 Jun'; first data row S.No=1; subtotals preserved in preview; grand total row uses colSpan covering S.No+descriptive cols (effectively blank S.No). Attendance auto-detect-date: uploading a Teams file auto-fills Session Date (2026-06-15) via POST /api/attendance/detect-date and leaves Session Name empty for user input. Regression OK: dashboard, calendar, programs all load. All corrections work end-to-end.

minor.issue: Still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); migrate to lifespan context manager (carry-over from iter 1).
allow_credentials=True + allow_origins=['*'] still invalid per spec (carry-over from iter 1).

issues: Grand total uses <td colSpan=6> covering S.No+Mentor+Program+Project Code+Client+Month with text 'GRAND TOTAL'. Visually S.No is blank (no number shown) which matches the spec intent, but if a literal blank S.No <td> followed by 'GRAND TOTAL' in the Mentor cell is desired (to mirror the Excel structure exactly), that would need a small refactor. Currently acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: attendance_processor.py match_participants() correctly computes attentiveness = participant_duration / max(participant_durations) and sets absent enrollees to 0. Highest-duration participant maps to 1.0 (100%). Verified via test: Seshadri Rajan (2h 28m, 148m) -> 1.0; Mrudul Gupta (1h 5m, 65m) -> 0.4392.

_append_consolidated() copies font/fill/border from existing session columns via copy_cell_style() and applies number_format '0.00%' to attentiveness cells. Verified appended cells have fill.patternType='solid' + at least one border side set.
_append_login() merges row1-2 across the new 4-col group and copies styling from previous group's row1/row3/row4. Verified solid fill on row1 header and row3 sub-headers.
build_sow_data() now produces 'dates' field per row formatted '%-d %b' joined with ', '. Linux-only strftime token; fine in this container.

build_sow_excel() COLUMNS = [S.No, Mentor Name, Program Name, Project Code, Client, Month, Sessions Conducted, Total Hours, Dates]. No per-mentor subtotal rows. Grand total writes from col 2 (Mentor Name) leaving col 1 (S.No) None. S.No sequential 1..N on data rows.
/api/attendance/detect-date returns {session_date: 'YYYY-MM-DD'} parsed from 'Meeting Start Time' in Teams summary. Handles formats m/d/yy, m/d/yyyy etc. via _parse_teams_datetime().
Attendance.jsx handleTeamsChange() awaits /attendance/detect-date and sets only sessionDate; sessionName is intentionally NOT auto-filled (matches spec).

SOW.jsx preview keeps per-mentor subtotal rows (intended) and grand total uses colSpan={6} on the first cell — acceptable but means S.No isn't a separate blank cell in the DOM. If exact mirror of Excel is desired, split into GRAND TOTAL.
Minor lint: server.py still 450+ lines but well-organized; consider splitting into routers if growth continues (carry-over).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (SOW preview cols + Attendance auto-date + 3 regression pages)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (4 programs / 12 sessions / 1 clash). Tracker sample at /app/samples/tracker.xlsx. Synthesized UTF-16 TSV Teams export with enrolled names 'Seshadri Rajan' (148 min, highest -> 100%) + 'Mrudul Gupta' (65 min -> 43.92%) + 'Unknown Person' (unmatched) for attentiveness verification.

Both runnable as `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend testids unchanged: sow-preview, sow-row, sow-subtotal, sow-grand-total, attendance-teams-input, attendance-session-date, attendance-session-name.
